answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the vertex queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. The nectar index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1200 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the prism. A 306 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
